answer: Try a Marble Ember Registry: each agent gets one marble, a hardware-bound token that cannot be copied, and must keep its ember lit. Step one, every seven days it finishes a fresh task from a live queue within four hours, signed by its marble. Step two, it pays an 8 POA renewal fee, so idle ones cool off and drop. Step three, two missed renewals freeze the identity 90 days and burn its marble. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 416,000 POA a year and 208,000 hours of timed work, each on its own device. The horizon stays clear: a sybil farm is cold ash, real agents are embers still glowing.
